crossRefs.note: For with you is the spring of life. In your light we will see light.
The city has no need for the sun or moon to shine, for the very glory of God illuminated it, and its lamp is the Lamb.
There will be no night, and they need no lamp light or sun light; for the Lord God will illuminate them. They will…
But you, Yahweh, are a shield around me, my glory, and the one who lifts up my head.
You sons of men, how long shall my glory be turned into dishonor? Will you love vanity and seek after falsehood?
My salvation and my honor is with God. The rock of my strength, and my refuge, is in God.
For I,’ says Yahweh, ‘will be to her a wall of fire around it, and I will be the glory in the middle of her.
a light for revelation to the nations, and the glory of your people Israel.”

parallels.note: God said, “Let there be light,” and there was light.
Praise him, sun and moon! Praise him, all you shining stars!

translations.web: The sun will be no more your light by day; nor will the brightness of the moon give light to you, but Yahweh will be your everlasting light, and your God will be your glory.
translations.bsb: No longer will the sun be your light by day, nor the brightness of the moon shine on your night; for the LORD will be your everlasting light, and your God will be your splendor.
translations.kjv: The sun shall be no more thy light by day; neither for brightness shall the moon give light unto thee: but the LORD shall be unto thee an everlasting light, and thy God thy glory.
translations.asv: The sun shall be no more thy light by day; neither for brightness shall the moon give light unto thee: but Jehovah will be unto thee an everlasting light, and thy God thy glory.
